content:
Carlos: Hey team, kicking off onboarding for client Ora tomorrow. Main goals: get them to first successful end-to-end demo, surface any renewal risks early, and hand off enablement. Quick ask: confirm who's attending from our side and Ora.

Rebecca: I'll run product walkthrough + training. Planning two 45-min sessions: PMs and Devs. Will capture session recordings and a one-pager.

Ibrahim: I'll cover infra & deployment. Need API key provisioning, sample traffic profile, and confirmation if they want Dedicated vs Private. If Private, timeline likely +2 weeks. Tagging RISK-PRIVATE.

Lina: I'll own success metrics and renewal signal tracking. Propose baseline: 30k tokens/day by day 10 and 3 feature flows used by 5 unique users.

Carlos: Rough onboarding sprint (compact):
```
Day 0: kick/roles + SSO check
Day 1-2: API integration + smoke tests
Day 3-5: perf + batching tuning
Day 6-8: enablement sessions
Day 9-11: feedback capture + go/no-go
```
Can folks post blockers before EOD? :spiral_calendar_pad:

Rebecca: I'll publish the enablement deck later today: https://go.redwood/ora-enablement

Ibrahim: SSO note 1: if SSO certs delayed > 5 days, we lose reliable telemetry for early adoption. Marking RISK-SSO. Also need access to their staging VPC (jumpbox details).

Lina: For success criteria I suggest: integration green, 3 demo flows passing, average 95th percentile latency <350ms on 512-token samples, and positive training feedback >80% on post-session survey.

Carlos: Owners: Rebecca = enablement & docs, Ibrahim = infra & test access, Lina = metrics & renewal watch. I'll handle exec synces and escalations.

Rebecca: Quick test curl example to share with Ora devs:```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'```

Ibrahim: Please ensure customer shares test key by EOD tomorrow so we can run quantization and throughput runs.

onboard-bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.checklists/1801239876 1 includes roles, meeting links, enablement deck, and RISK tags.

Lina: I'll create the post-session feedback form and wire it into the success dashboard. Link when live.

Carlos: Thanks all. If you hit a blocker call it out here with RISK tag. We'll do a 10-min stand daily at 09:30 PST during the sprint. :thumbsup:
